app_lines_per_service_s.note: unattributed app lines per service per second

sentry.note: normalised span bytes per client record

vl.note: normalised span bytes per platform record (proxy for the raw line)

cart_fallback_rate.note: audit lines whose session id was the cart id

auth_expired_share.note: share of sessions presenting an expired credential

auto_captured_share.note: client errors lacking the app-tagged request id

error_rate.note: client error events per edge request

logged_in_share.note: session-level sequences with an account hash

net_flaky_share.note: share of sessions on a flaky network

txn_sampling.note: platform tracesSampleRate (front-end configuration in the test environment)

browser_sd.note: sd of (browser error time - backend access time) for tagged errors; includes network and processing time

server_sd.note: sd of internal-hop lines stamped after their edge request's completion (an upper bound on server skew)

daily_profile.note: mean traces per hour of day over the archive, normalised to mean 1

depth_pmf.note: P(max service-chain depth below the root = 1, 2, 3+), conditional on a chain existing; root-only traces excluded

4xx.note: share of spans in the tier

5xx.note: share of spans in the tier

err.note: share of spans in the tier

4xx.note: share of spans in the tier

5xx.note: share of spans in the tier

err.note: share of spans in the tier

4xx.note: share of spans in the tier

5xx.note: share of spans in the tier

err.note: share of spans in the tier

degraded.note: share of requests a DEGRADED endpoint fails during an incident, mixed on top of the nominal classes (ok = 1 - share); sized so an injected degradation at least doubles a hop's error rate (PRD scenario 8)

failed.note: class distribution of a FAILED endpoint

pool_exhausted.note: share of requests an EXHAUSTED pool fails (503-like)

fanout_pmf_by_depth.note: P(number of SERVER callees = 0..4) for a SERVER span at depth 0, 1, 2

health_check_period_s.note: median inter-arrival of health-check access lines per pod

cache_cold.note: caller own-time multiplier when its cache is COLD (misses)

degraded.note: own-time multiplier of a DEGRADED endpoint; chosen so a degraded hop's p50 lands near its nominal p95

pool_exhausted.note: own-time multiplier under an EXHAUSTED pool

pool_tight.note: own-time multiplier under a TIGHT connection pool (queueing)

pods_per_service.note: distinct pods per service seen in access lines, 1..4+

access.note: one access line per hop attempt by construction of the platform

app_err.note: app lines per request whose access status >= 400

app_ok.note: app lines per request whose access status < 400 (error-gated sink)

mean_retries.note: share of spans carrying a retry counter >= 1

p_retry_5xx.note: mean_retries / P(5xx or error): the retry probability given a retry-eligible failure that reproduces mean_retries

p50.note: seconds between consecutive audited responses within a session (> 1.5 s)

p90.note: seconds between consecutive audited responses within a session (> 1.5 s)

p95.note: seconds between consecutive audited responses within a session (> 1.5 s)

p99.note: seconds between consecutive audited responses within a session (> 1.5 s)

cut_chars.note: the platform's log-line cut length (platform configuration), at which long lines are split into parts

key_part_pmf.note: which part (1..3) of a split line carries the audit keys; the platform's own documentation states the identifiers routinely land in part 2 of 3, and the merged feed cannot expose the split — declared, not measured

rate.note: share of app/audit lines split into parts

cache_cold_given_high.note: per-tick hazard WARM -> COLD under HIGH load

health_degraded_base.note: per-tick hazard HEALTHY -> DEGRADED otherwise (mean ~33 min)

health_degraded_given_exhausted.note: per-tick hazard HEALTHY -> DEGRADED while the pool is EXHAUSTED

health_recover.note: per-tick recovery hazard toward HEALTHY (mean 50 s)

load_persist.note: P(service load level unchanged per tick)

pool_exhausted_given_high.note: per-tick hazard TIGHT -> EXHAUSTED under HIGH load

pool_tight_given_high.note: per-tick hazard FREE -> TIGHT under HIGH load

unattributed_fraction.note: spans attributed to no actor in the pipeline's own histogram

vocab_size.note: distinct SERVER-kind operations (HTTP endpoints) in the operation vocabulary

weekday.note: mean traces per weekday over the archive, normalised to mean 1

sources.A: application-log and browser error-tracking feed of a consumer web platform (test-environment window), normalised by the platform's correlation pipeline
sources.B: distributed-trace archive of a production data centre (hourly span parquet, operation vocabulary, per-hour build statistics)
sources.spec: structural design choice of the mechanism, declared with a rationale (see mechanism-spec.json), not measured
